display_title: [Explicit Fairy Tale Anthology] Young Master, Take the Water
description:
“Byeon Ha-Yeon,” who has been living in men's clothing as a stand-in for her deceased older brother, returns to her hometown, “Yadam Village,” as the local magistrate. With a trembling heart, she goes to find her first love, “Seong Chun-Ha,” whom she has never been able to forget even after leaving her hometown. However, the innocent boy Chun-Ha is nowhere to be found; instead, she encounters a man who has become skilled in debauchery...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: The third story in Coconut's Jeonradonghwa Danpyeonseon (전라동화全裸童話 단편선) Collection.*
